title: useAsyncState Hook
description:
Implement a `useAsyncState` hook that manages the lifecycle of an async operation. It returns `{ data, loading, error, execute }`. Calling `execute()` triggers the async function, sets `loading: true`, and then populates either `data` or `error` on completion.

**Example:**
```tsx
const { data, loading, error, execute } = useAsyncState(() => fetchUser(id));
```
ai_context: Learners often forget to reset error state before re-executing, so a stale error remains visible even after a successful second call.
